description: In lexicographic order on natural pairs, (i,j+1) immediately follows (i,j), and every (i,0) with i>0 is a limit point.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.lex_successors_limits :
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), toLex (i, j) ⋖ toLex (i, j + 1)) ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → Order.IsSuccLimit (toLex (i, 0))
